comments.body: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-16 (0.16.0, Codex on the devenv, version not noted): a hand recording of Codex's `/compact`. `muster pane compact --pane p2bjgf98za <focus>` refused: "codex gives Muster no way to compact it from its prompt, so pane ... is left as it is". Typing `/compact` with `muster pane send --enter` at an idle, empty prompt worked at once: Codex printed "Context compacted" and its footer read "Context 6% used". Nobody tried giving it a focus. Afterwards `muster window` still showed the pane at 71%, because Codex's context comes from its hooks reading the transcript and no hook ran. Adding `[session] compact` for Codex therefore also wants a fresh context reading after it, from the transcript or the footer. The same send with `--confirm` reported the line not taken, which is a_2hIftWa0n.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-11-11: Codex done on main (84213b9e): muster pane compact types /compact (Codex 0.167.0 sends extra words to the model, so a focus is refused), and its PostCompact hook reads the token count Codex writes after a compaction, so the context reading is fresh. OpenCode 1.19.5 recorded and not added: its command list takes the first Return, and only a second runs /compact, while Muster types one line with one Return (docs/observations/opencode-1.19.5.md). Open for the owner: whether the manifest format gains a way to say a command needs a second Return.
comments.author: Alexander Terp
